blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with a restrained blue-gray palette and clear panel labeling, but the network graph is too dense to extract signal and the layout is cramped with minimal breathing room between panels.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for node radius, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max, and utcMonth-binned thresholds — all core encoding rules followed with no lie factor or dual-axis risk.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, pointer events prevent mouse-touch fights, and no D3 transitions risk mid-flight snaps, but bitFilter.set() runs O(n) on every brush mousemove (not just 'end') and the list view fully reconstructs innerHTML on each dirty-flag flush.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: The 4-panel crossfilter layout stays within working memory limits and the timeline, color scatter, and thumbnail panels are individually clear, but the force network renders as a dense hairball where edge crossings overwhelm any cluster structure, undermining the dashboard's primary analytical view.
